questions.question: God promised to live in Jerusalem again. What did He say His mountain there would be called?
God told Judah and Israel they had been a curse among the nations. What did He say they would become?
What did the LORD say the fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months would become for Judah?

answers.text: Times of rest for the land

questions.question: In God's promise about Jerusalem's future, ten men from the nations grasp a Jew's robe. What reason do they give?

answers.text: We have heard that God is with you
We have lost our way in the city
We have come to collect a debt
